steps: Cook Rice in 600 ml water in a covered saucepan over medium heat for 18 minutes, until all water is absorbed.
Peel and dice Sweet potato into 1 cm cubes; dice cooked Carrot to the same size.
Cut Chicken into small 1 cm pieces, removing any tendons.
Heat Olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add Garlic and Sweet potato; cook for 8 minutes, stirring often, until sweet potato is fork-tender.
Add Chicken pieces and Turmeric; cook for 6 to 7 minutes, until no pink remains.
Pour in Unsalted chicken broth and cooked Carrot; simmer for 3 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Spoon mixture over Rice; serve warm. Yields 4 family portions. Refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.
